nodes.name: Get All Contacts
nodes.notes: Reads your existing Contacts sheet (ID | Name | Number, header row 3, data from row 4) — the same one the Tasks sheet's dropdown and phone-lookup formula already use.

parameters.content:
## 🎙️ Boss Voice Note -> New Task (matched to your real sheet)
Boss sends a WhatsApp VOICE NOTE. Wire the first node from your existing 'Meta Webhook Receive (POST)'. Gemini transcribes + extracts {contact_name, task, due_date, frequency}. We then match contact_name against your real Contacts sheet (exact match required, since your Phone Number formula uses MATCH exact-text) to get the canonical name, write it plus Task/Due Date/Frequency into the next blank row, and tick the Send checkbox (col G). Task ID and Phone Number are left to your existing formulas.

We deliberately do NOT send the assignee a WhatsApp message ourselves — your existing 'On Sheet Row Update' poll-trigger workflow already does that automatically the moment Phone Number populates and Status isn't 'Sent'. Adding our own send here would double-message people. We only confirm to the boss.

SETUP: (1) Gemini API key + n8n HTTP Query Auth credential named 'Gemini API'. (2) Verify 'Convert Audio to Base64' node type for your n8n version. (3) HEADROOM: Contact Name dropdown validation only covers rows up to B149 (you're at 135) and Task ID/Phone formulas are filled to row 216 — extend both down a few hundred rows soon so this doesn't quietly stop working. (4) Currently testing with only your own number in BOSS_NUMBERS.

## A. 09:00 IST - build the form and WhatsApp it
App -> today's tasks -> Apps Script builds independent Google Form -> WhatsApp link to the Senior Authority.
Tasks are automatically generated and locked if not already locked. Forms are independent per day.

parameters.content:
## B. Form submitted -> update the app -> (optional) WhatsApp the employees
Google Form -> Apps Script -> this webhook -> app updates the checklist (the app now shows the answers).
We answer the webhook as soon as the app is updated, so Apps Script only retries if the app update failed.
NOTIFY_EMPLOYEES = false by default: flip it to true when you are ready for real not-done WhatsApps + escalations.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, duplicate: $json.duplicate === true, counts: $json.counts || null }) }}

parameters.content:
## Before activating
1. Create 2 credentials -> Header Auth:
   - 'Swift App Secret (x-cron-secret)': name x-cron-secret, value = your app's CRON_SECRET
   - 'Swift Form Webhook Secret': name x-webhook-secret, value = same as Apps Script N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET
2. Pick your existing WhatsApp credential on the 4 WhatsApp nodes.
3. Fill the two Config nodes (Apps Script URL + bridge secret, app URL).
4. Run 'Manual: Send Form Now', submit the form, check the app. Then Activate.

nodes.name: Forward To Swift App?
nodes.notes: Only plain TEXT messages that are not the 'menu'/'report' keywords go to the Swift Senior Checklist app. Voice notes, list replies and status callbacks are untouched.

parameters.content:
## Swift Senior Checklist: employee replies
WIRE ONE CONNECTION: `Extract Message Data` -> `Forward To Swift App?` (keep its existing outputs to `Respond 200 OK` and `Is Menu Keyword?`).
Then attach the 'Swift App Secret (x-cron-secret)' credential to the HTTP node.
